The '''TQ-895 capacitor component''' was produced by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The TQ-895 was designed to boost the energy output of a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] primary weapons.
